card.fact_statement: The epicenter of the 2025 Myanmar earthquake was close to Mandalay.
card.source_span: On 28 March 2025, at 12:50:52 MMT (06:20:52 UTC), a moment magnitude (Mw) 7.7–7.9 earthquake struck the Sagaing Region of Myanmar, with an epicenter close to Mandalay, the country's second-largest city.
